read_me_first.headline: Stance: RISK OFF. SPY's daily, weekly and 5-day trend checks disagree with each other — that is chop, and chop is where breakouts get sold.
because: SPY's daily, weekly and 5-day trend checks disagree with each other — that is chop, and chop is where breakouts get sold.
SPY sits 0.88 ATRs above its 50-day line (not stretched). QQQ sits 3.46 ATRs above its 50-day line (not stretched). VIX/VIX3M is 0.91 — neither calm nor stressed.
Real leadership this week: Chip Equipment, Cybersecurity, Solar Renewables — strong on both the weekly and monthly read.
read_me_first.so_what: Breadth is against the tape — build the watchlist, do not push new entries.
read_me_first.note: Rule-based reading, not a prediction — see docs/AQE_VALEN_DASHBOARD_PROPOSAL.md.

gex.commentary: Below flip: moves get amplified. Cut size, tighten stops.
gex.assumption: Customers are long calls and long puts, so dealers are long call gamma and short put gamma. This is the standard convention, NOT observed data — exchange feeds publish open interest, never who is on which side.
gex.dealer_read: Volatile market — dealers are short gamma and amplify moves in both directions: support ~745, breakout level ~771 (reclaiming it calms the market), resistance ~785.

neighbourhood: On both the week and month lists (real leadership): Chip Equipment, Cybersecurity, Solar Renewables, Semiconductors, Enterprise Software
Leading from their own highs, not just bouncing: Enterprise Software, Cloud Computing, Mag7, Biotech, Cybersecurity
Strong numbers but still well off their highs (a bounce, not leadership yet): Agri Commodities, Oil Services, Critical Minerals, Defense Tech, Gaming Streaming
